observations: To Robin, a possible conflict in the requirements: the V2 delta 'USB mouth X in [-1.8, -0.8]' contradicts L2.1.3's own rule ('first header pin on the grid column nearest the -X edge'). For the catalogue 90 x 45 board the grid starts at X=5.63 (grid_margin_x 4.74, 32 columns). A mouth in [-1.8, -0.8] puts the first Pico pin at X 0.87-1.87, which has no grid hole, so L3.1.6.1 (weight 1) must then fail. As written, V2 cannot MEET with this catalogue grid. This design follows L2.1.3's text (pin on grid column 0, mouth at 2.96) and fails only the delta's number. Graded as written.

The Pico PCB's -Y edge (Y=12.0, Z 2.5-3.5) touches the end faces of jack 1 (X 21-27) and jack 2 (X 42-48) with zero gap. The intersection volume is 0, so L3.1.4.1 passes, but the parts have no assembly tolerance (ghost_top.png: the jack rectangles butt against the Pico).
Margins to the keep-outs are only 0.10 mm (lid lip bottom Z 12.1 vs 12.0; floor top Z -5.7 vs -5.6). They pass, but have little slack for slicer error.

The renders match the measurements: a rectangular USB opening in the -X end (model_left.png), three round openings in the long -Y wall (model_front.png, model_iso.png), external corner bosses with lid screw holes (model_top.png), and no openings in +X/+Y (model_right.png, model_back.png).
